Chapter 6422: Revived

Chapter 6422: Revived

“Devil Emperor!” Nine-cries roared in his dismembered state.

The others also bellowed, not expecting Goldblade’s ambush.

“How dare you?!” Heavenly Crane’s roar caused a gigantic tsunami.

“Die!” He was livid and sent down a divine light. It condensed into a gigantic palm.

“God Crane Palm!” Luosha and Goldblade’s expression darkened.

The palm covered all of Imperial League, crushing the barriers and the sea floor.

“Go!” Luosha leaped upward instead of running; her primal anima turned into longevity. A life ring appeared, eternal and indestructible.

“Luosha Annihilation!” She also summoned a radiant pagoda to stop the palm strike, unleashing a sharp light.

“I will help you!” Goldblade spewed out an anima in his mouth. It empowered his blade as he swung. Once he activated his grand dao and fused it into his blade, it caught up to Luosha’s attack immediately.

“Protect!” He pushed his dao to the extreme. The blade aligned and fused with the pagoda’s light, gleaming brightly.

Their combined effort cut through the sky vault, leaving behind an indelible scar.

“Clank!” Upon impact, it sounded as if they were hitting the toughest thing in the world. Sparks and embers splashed everywhere.

Alas, they didn’t leave a mark on the palm, let alone cut it down due to the insurmountable gap.

The force of the palm continued pressing down, enough to injure everyone beneath despite the distance.

“Not good!” Luosha and Goldblade assumed a defensive pose.

One had an anima tree while the other used the life ring to encompass ten million miles. Both failed to stop the shockwaves.

“Crack!” They fell from the sky with shattered bones.

The palm continued to descend, wanting to reduce them to blood while destroying Imperial League’s barriers. It contained Heavenly Crane Master’s dao along with the peak’s divinity.

“Illusory Fist!” Ocean-gaze roared while controlling the grand momentum.

“Rumble!” All of the water nearby came together to follow his fist. He didn’t hold back with the overbearing attack.

“Bam!” Space shattered into a black hole.

Since all the water was pushed upward, the ocean floor became visible and severely damaged.

Ocean-gaze lost the exchange despite using his best technique, tumbling backward while vomiting blood.

Heavenly Crane was already stronger, not to mention the help of the unique peak.

“Retreat!” Virtuoso gave the order to shrink the barriers again with Ocean-gaze in the center. Consolidation was the only way to keep up against Heavenly Crane.

They also brought the injured Luosha and Goldblade back to their camp.

“Buzz.” Immortal-seek Peak landed inside Imperial League. Flames flew out and coiled around the beheaded emperors.

“Zzz.” They wrapped the emperors and channeled divinity into them.

“Get up, how pathetic.” Ocean-gaze said after healing them.

Nine-cries, Ghost-sparrow, Ravenous Wolf God, and Heavenpray appeared again.

“Revived?” Members of Imperial League became frightened.
